name: Objaverse 1.0: A Universe of 800K+ Annotated 3D Objects
description: Objaverse 1.0 is an enormous open-access repository of over 800,000 richly textured 3D models with detailed descriptive metadata and semantic category mappings. Created by the Allen Institute for AI, it provides diverse 3D objects with materials, textures, and animations, fueling breakthrough research in text-to-3D generation, zero-shot view synthesis, and 3D visual perception.
